title: OpenPLC Runtime Modbus Stack Buffer Overflow
description: A stack-based buffer overflow in the Modbus/TCP request parser of OpenPLC Runtime v3 allows unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary code or cause a Denial of Service via a crafted Modbus FC16 frame.
remediation: Upgrade OpenPLC Runtime to v3.2 or enforce strict deep-packet inspection on Modbus FC16 write commands.

title: Siemens SIMATIC S7-1200 Hardcoded Cryptographic Key Exposure
description: Siemens SIMATIC S7-1200 and S7-1500 CPU firmware prior to v4.5 uses a global hardcoded cryptographic key for TLS communications, allowing remote attackers to intercept and forge PLC control communications.
remediation: Update CPU firmware to v4.5+ and enable TLS 1.3 individual certificate validation.

title: Schneider Electric Modicon M221 Unauthenticated Modbus Write Command Execution
description: Schneider Electric Modicon M221 PLCs do not properly authenticate Modbus FC05/FC06 coil/register write operations, permitting unauthorized control manipulations from any network host with TCP 502 access.
remediation: Restrict TCP port 502 access to authorized HMI/SCADA IPs using network ACLs and enable read-only Modbus mode.

title: Schneider Electric EcoStruxure Operator Terminal Expert Memory Corruption
description: A memory corruption vulnerability in EcoStruxure Operator Terminal Expert allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on HMI operator workstations when parsing maliciously crafted project files.
remediation: Apply vendor security patch v3.1 SP1 and restrict EWS file transfer permissions.

title: Rockwell Automation Logix Controllers Authentication Bypass
description: Rockwell Automation FactoryTalk Logix Controllers accept unauthenticated CIP engineering commands allowing remote users to modify controller logic, set points, or force physical outputs.
remediation: Turn controller keyswitch to RUN mode to prevent remote programming edits and enforce CIP Security.

title: Ignition SCADA / HMI Unauthenticated API Remote Code Execution
description: Inductive Automation Ignition SCADA web gateway contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability on HTTP API endpoints, leading to unauthenticated remote system takeover.
remediation: Upgrade Ignition gateway to v8.1.28 and restrict web access to trusted management subnets.
